=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:1606-2035 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The PR adds `MERGE_LEASE_TTL_MINUTES: ${{ vars.MERGE_LEASE_TTL_MINUTES || '240' }}` (lines 1606, 1866, 2032) and `MERGE_LEASE_IDLE_MINUTES: ${{ vars.MERGE_LEASE_IDLE_MINUTES || '60' }}` (lines 1609, 1869, 2035) to the three poller steps. Since #10046 merged, `scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh` defaults to 480/180, so these 240/60 defaults are out of date.
  WHY: CI run 45608850132 fails on these lines. Shard 31 `test_repo_workflows_satisfy_contract` reports "MERGE_LEASE_TTL_MINUTES default '240' differs from the scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh default '480'" for "Process each tracking issue", "Run standalone stall recovery without active projects" and "Run standalone PR sweeps without active projects". Shard 12 `tests/test_merge_lease.py::Wiring::test_lease_ttl_and_idle_defaults_agree_at_every_site` fails with "'240' != '480'". If the repository variables are unset, these steps would grant or renew leases at 240/60 while every other lease step uses 480/180. All reviewers rated this BLOCKER, recorded here as critical.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:252-980 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The same out-of-date defaults appear in the sweep's two lease steps, "Enumerate open PRs and dispatch internal-review.yml" and "Ensure the final CI run on reviewed PR heads". TTL is '240' at lines 252 and 977 and IDLE is '60' at lines 255 and 980, where the post-#10046 script defaults are 480/180.
  WHY: Shard 31 reports four violations (TTL '240' vs '480' and IDLE '60' vs '180' for both steps), and the shard 12 Wiring defaults test also fails. With the variables unset, the sweep would renew leases at 240 minutes while every other site uses 480. That is the same mismatch the issue is meant to remove. All reviewers rated this BLOCKER, recorded here as critical.
- tests/test_merge_lease_env_contract.py:45-148 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: Rule 5 in `violations()` rejects any `MERGE_LEASE_*` key that is in neither `REQUIRED_KEYS` nor `UNWIRED_KEYS`. `MERGE_LEASE_HOLD_LABELS` is in neither list, but main already passes it in two steps: cancel_on_pr_close.yml "Release merge-queued PRs (merge train)" and orchestrate_poll.yml "Release merge-queued PRs (merge train backstop)".
  WHY: Shard 31 `test_repo_workflows_satisfy_contract` fails for both steps with "unknown merge-lease setting MERGE_LEASE_HOLD_LABELS", so the test stays red even after the TTL/IDLE fix. All reviewers rated this BLOCKER, recorded here as critical.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "If #10046 has merged, use its new defaults; if not, keep today's and let the defaults test follow whichever is on the branch." / "The defaults in the workflows equal the script defaults in `scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh` (one test compares them)."
  expected_change_site: The PR-added `MERGE_LEASE_TTL_MINUTES` / `MERGE_LEASE_IDLE_MINUTES` lines at .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:1606/1609/1866/1869/2032/2035 and .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:252/255/977/980
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: #10046 is in the merge base (32c7bffd; merge ref b976fb1a), where the script defaults are 480/180. No hunk in the PR diff or the last-run diff adopts 480/180; the added lines still carry '240'/'60', and the branch has not been updated from main. Shard 31 reports 7 default-mismatch violations (TTL at 5 sites, IDLE at 2), and shard 12 fails `Wiring::test_lease_ttl_and_idle_defaults_agree_at_every_site`. The changelog fragment changelog.d/10078-merge-lease-env-full-set.md:2 says the steps use "the same defaults as every other lease step", which is false on the merge ref.
- requirement: "The new contract test passes on the fixed workflows." The test must classify every MERGE_LEASE_* env key that any workflow step passes (rule 5).
  expected_change_site: `REQUIRED_KEYS` / `UNWIRED_KEYS` in tests/test_merge_lease_env_contract.py:45-62 (the unknown-key branch of `violations()` is around lines 136-147)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: `MERGE_LEASE_HOLD_LABELS` is in neither list, yet main passes it in cancel_on_pr_close.yml (job `cancel-active-runs`, step "Release merge-queued PRs (merge train)") and orchestrate_poll.yml (job `poll`, step "Release merge-queued PRs (merge train backstop)"). The PR checkout has no `HOLD_LABELS` anywhere. Shard 31 of CI run 45608850132 fails `test_repo_workflows_satisfy_contract` for both steps. minimax_minimax-m3 adds that the rule 5 docstring (lines 27-30) should name the key.
